title: Mexico formalizes and expands import tariffs to more than 1,400 products — key impacts for the automotive sector and beyond
date_evidence: # Mexico formalizes and expands import tariffs to more than 1,400 products—key impacts for the automotive sector and beyond ... Alert ... 29 December 2025
key_claim: Mexico's December 2025 reform to the Law of the General Import and Export Taxes formalises and expands tariff increases on 1,463 tariff lines from non-FTA countries (including China, India, South Korea, Vietnam, Thailand, Brazil, Indonesia), with duties from 5% to 50%; entered into force 1 January 2026 with indefinite validity; explicitly targets non-FTA suppliers and consolidates earlier executive decrees into permanent legislative measure.
notes: Structural anchor: 29 December 2025 publication is the canonical legal-policy source for Mexico's January 2026 tariff reform — a load-bearing event for the Global South defensive-industrialism framing. 149 days from scan date, within 3-6 month structural-anchor band.
